column3: Manami Route · Talking in the Park
Yesterday, Manami told me, "There's something I want to tell you." So we headed to the park along the way home.
...I guess even unusual things do happen, huh.
Kyou-chan, there's something I want to talk about. May I?
What's with the formality? Besides, that's why we're here right? Just go ahead.
Yes, thank you. You see, actually--
Hm? A phone call? Sorry Manami, wait a minute.
S-Sure.
Hello?
Answer immediately when I call you!
Oh Kirino, is it? It's rare to get calls from you.
It's an emergency, so I have no other choice.
Emergency...? Did something happen?
W-Well! Moments ago, there was a sudden announcement on the blog!
Huh? What's that? Blog announcement?
Like I said～! It says they're holding a Meruru event right now in Akihabara--
Ah, I get it now... "That" kind of emergency.
What's wrong with..."that"?
At the moment, I already have plans that I can't just drop.
Huh? Why didn't I hear anything about this?
That's because I didn't tell you. Do I have to report to you now?
Wha, why are you so cocky--
Anyways, I can't come right now. If you want to go to Akiba, ask Kuroneko or someone else.
Hey! Hold it right there! First of all, I didn't even say one word about wanting to go to Akiba with you!
Yeah, yeah. I'm hanging up--
*sigh*...
Geez, that Kirino... Only she would think of that as an emergency...
I bet she just sees me as a servant to order around.
Hey, was that Kirino-chan just now?
Perhaps... that was an important matter...?
Nah, it's okay. It wasn't anything important.
Is... that so? That's fine then...
More importantly, let's continue. So, what was it?
Oh, well. Actually--
I need some life counseling.
I know, right?! I totally knew you'd say that! There's no way you'd betray the development! On the contrary, how refreshing!!!
Kyou-chan, what's wrong?! You suddenly seem very excited!
Nah, just talking to myself, just ignore it.
Hmm, so... you want some life counseling from me?
Yes.
It's not about you cutting your hair too short again, is it?
It's not about that! It's something more important!
Hmm... Okay, I understand.
Hm? Somehow, you suddenly look very serious about this.
I guess so. I kinda realized that everyone worries about the most unexpected things.
Oh～? I see.
So? What's the life counseling about?
...There!
Huh? What are you doing, pointing your finger at me?
...This!
*nodnod*
How troublesome! Ah well.  My... what?
It's about... relationships.
Relationships? So that's what this life counseling is about?
Y-Yes.
I don't understand this at all.
Well... lately, you seem to have been meeting and getting along with a lot of people, and they are all very cute girls...
Hmm... Now that she mentions it, that's certainly true.
Ever since Kirino's life counseling. I met Kuroneko, Saori, as well as Ayase, etc...
If I think carefully, it's all girls.
...In fact, isn't this the most popular I've ever been in my life?
...As if.
Kirino is my little sister, while Kuroneko is... *c-cough*! Kirino's otaku friend. Nothing more, nothing less.
The same holds true for Saori with her swirly glasses, and Ayase has reached the point where she strongly wants to erase me from society.
Also, recently, you haven't been going to the library as much anymore. That's why... it got me a little bit worried...
Manami is saying "a little bit"...
But because we've been together for a long time, I know that she's pretty worried when she actually voices her thoughts.
Indeed, she's worried about how I haven't been putting much effort in studying for the exams lately.
Manami, you really got the wrong idea. There's no way I can be popular!
Is that so?
You have a kind, gentle and caring attitude. And I believe that girls want to rely on you for that reason.
What's that? You're awfully generous with the praises today.
I've always thought that about you! So... it's making me a little worried.
...Worried? Ahh, so it's not about studying for the exams, but about being seen with one girl after another? And that they're Kirino's friends too...
Wait! You're mistaken, Manami!
Mistaken?
Right now, you're suspecting I somehow might be getting along too well with girls, right?
N-No, it's not like I'm suspicious... I'm just a little worried, that's all...
...Hold it, Kyousuke...
T-The fact that your childhood friend is worrying about how you 'might do something to your little sister's friends' is no joke!
No way! I'm not that kind of guy! There's no way!
...Really?
Of course! If you want proof, I'll do whatever it takes!
Um, then... Then...
Yeah! Ask me for anything!
How about... becoming my boyfriend?
This is the real purpose of my 'life counseling', Kyou-chan.
Well, about that... umm, Manami.
Yes?

N-No, it's not like I'm suspicious... I'm just a little worried, that's all...
...Hold it, Kyousuke.

...Really?
Of course! If you want proof, I'll do whatever it takes!
Um, then... Then...
Yeah! Ask me anything!
How about... becoming my boyfriend?

Though, "something I want to tell you"... what's with that vague statement? On top of that, she's been wearing a serious expression, like she's been deep
in thought for a while.
